newsitem.title: USA: U.S. Stockpile sells 553,293 lbs cobalt.
newsitem.headline: U.S. Stockpile sells 553,293 lbs cobalt.

text.p: U.S. Defense National Stockpile Center said it sold 553,293 lbs of cobalt at an average price of $18.25 a lb.
The high bidder was Powmet Inc, which bid $18.8615 a lb for 5,935 lbs. The low bidder was Glencore, which bid $18.05 a lb on two lots totalling 93,697 lbs.
Glencore also bought two other lots totalling 89,134 lbs at $18.50 a lb.
Hall Chemical, which bought 54,504 lbs at $18.25 a lb.
Sovereign, which bought three lots totalling 97,856 lbs, at bids ranging between $18.08 and $18.20 a lb.
FirstMiss Steel bought 8,137 lbs at $18.25 a lb.
Voss Metals bought 25,575 lbs at $18.277 a lb.
Considar bought 34,731 lbs at $18.40 a lb.
Phoenixx International boughtthree lots totalling 98,077 lbs at prices ranging betwen $18.12 and $18.42 a lb.
Sogem-Afrimet bought 45,647 lbs at $18.41 a lb.
Minor Metals bid $18.88 on two lots totalling 80,378 lbs, but it was thrown out by the Stockpile because its attached a condition calling for 100 percent quality verification.
Stockpile contracted the Minor Metals Trade Association to sample 25 percent of the cobalt offered for sale.
